prompt: Which Kiwi author died the same year as the first British Prime Minister to be elected after the end of World War 1?
answer:
The Kiwi author was **Ursula Bethell (1874–1945)**.

David Lloyd George became prime minister following the December 1918 general election—the first British general election after World War I—and died in 1945, the same year as Bethell.
